stations.title: Examination of the Cardiovascular System
stations.task: Examine this patient's cardiovascular system and present your findings.
examinerQuestions: Time the murmur you heard against the carotid pulse.
What does the character of the apex beat tell you?
Describe the JVP waveform you would expect in tricuspid regurgitation.
Grade the parasternal heave you felt and explain how you'd distinguish a right ventricular heave from a left atrial one.
What cuff size would you have chosen for this patient's arm, and why does it matter?
